dedupe_keys.name: hazard consistent aftershock ground motion intensity map and arrival time sampling for regional seismic risk analysis

description: Hazard Consistent Aftershock Ground Motion Intensity Map and Arrival Time Sampling for Regional Seismic Risk Analysis is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Jinyan Zhao, University of California Berkeley (berkeley.edu). This repository contains the code and data generated for the paper "Hazard Consistent Aftershock Ground Motion Intensity Map and Arrival Time Sampling for Regional Seismic Risk Analysis" which is submitted to Earthquake Spectra. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 12 top-level files (RTF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-wmsa-7t50. Keywords: Aftershock probabilistic seismic hazard analysis, Regional seismic risk analysis, Spatially distributed infrastructure, Hazard-consistent event selection. Published 2025-07-02. Facility named: SimCenter. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
